welcome.tagline: Find parks, post clips, meet the locals.
welcome.inviteOnly: New here? Grindylocks is invite only for now. Ask a skater you know to send you an invite link.

email.title: Sign in with email
email.body: We'll email you a code. No password needed.
email.label: Email
email.invalid: That doesn't look like an email address.
email.notMember: There's no account for that email yet. Grindylocks is invite only for now, so ask a skater you know for an invite link.
email.rateLimited: Too many codes in a short time. Wait a minute and try again.

code.title: Check your email
code.body: We sent a code to {{email}}. Enter it below.
code.label: Code
code.wrong: That code is wrong or has expired. Check it, or send a new one.

age.title: Are you 16 or older?
age.body: Grindylocks is for skaters 16 and up. We only save that you said yes, never your birthday.
age.tooYoungBody: Grindylocks is for skaters 16 and older for now. We'll still be here.

username.title: Who's rolling?
username.label: Username
username.invalid: Use 2–30 letters, numbers, dots or underscores.

city.title: Where do you skate?
city.body: Your city sets up your feed and who to follow. Only signed-in members see it.
city.announceBody: Let skaters in {{city}} know someone new joined. Turn it off to join quietly.

regulars.title: Heads up: you're a regular
regulars.body: Post at a park more than 5 times, or make it your home park, and you show up in its regulars list. That tells other members where you skate.
regulars.point1: Only signed-in members see regulars lists.
regulars.point2: Private accounts never appear in them.
regulars.point3: You can hide yourself any time in settings.

home.title: Home
home.feedSoon: Your feed is coming. For now, here are your own posts.

errors.network: Couldn't reach Grindylocks. Check your connection and try again.

post.limits: Photos and clips up to 60 s each
post.rejectedTooLong_one: {{count}} clip is over 60 seconds. Trim it in your Photos app first.
post.rejectedTooLong_other: {{count}} clips are over 60 seconds. Trim them in your Photos app first.
post.rejectedTooBig_one: {{count}} clip is too big to upload (over 200 MB). Export it at 1080p and try again.
post.rejectedTooBig_other: {{count}} clips are too big to upload (over 200 MB). Export them at 1080p and try again.
post.rejectedUnsupported_one: {{count}} file isn't a photo or clip Grindylocks can use (JPEG, PNG, HEIC, MOV or MP4).
post.rejectedUnsupported_other: {{count}} files aren't photos or clips Grindylocks can use (JPEG, PNG, HEIC, MOV or MP4).
post.backgroundNote: Uploads keep going in the background, even on bad signal.
post.preparing: Getting your photos and clips ready…

uploads.errorTooLong: A clip is over 60 seconds, so it was turned down.
uploads.errorVideoNotConfigured: Clip uploads aren't switched on yet.
uploads.errorRejected: The upload didn't go through. Try again, or delete the post.
uploads.discardBody: It hasn't been posted yet. This removes it and its uploads.

viewer.title: Post
viewer.videoUnavailable: Clips can't play yet: video playback isn't set up.

map.noParksHere: No parks on this part of the map yet.
map.loadError: Couldn't load parks. Check your connection.

search.hint: Search by city, park name or what locals call it.

park.savedLabel: {{park}} is saved to want to skate. Tap to remove it.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.empty: Nothing yet. Comments, tags and invites will show up here.

messages.title: Messages
messages.heading: Direct messages are on the way
messages.body: Until then, say hi in the comments, tag people in your posts, or find skaters through a park's regulars.

find.title: Search
find.hint: Find skaters by username, or parks by name or what locals call them.

parkPhotos.full: This park already has {{max}} photos. Remove one to add another.
parkPhotos.unsupported: Some of those couldn't be added. Park photos can be JPEG, PNG or HEIC.
parkPhotos.noneYet: This park has no photos yet
parkPhotos.tipWide: Two or three wide, landscape shots of the whole park work best.
parkPhotos.tipPeople: Leave people out, or keep them too small to recognise. Riding shots go in posts.
parkPhotos.tipRights: Only add photos you took or have permission to use.
parkPhotos.photographerHint: Shown as "Photo by …" in the gallery.
parkPhotos.licenseHint: "own" for your photos, "permission" when the park said yes, or the license name, like CC BY-SA 4.0.
parkPhotos.failed: That didn't upload. Check your connection and try again.
parkPhotos.partFailed: {{done}} of {{count}} added. The rest didn't upload; try again.
parkPhotos.swipeHint: Swipe for more. Skating shots live in posts;
parkPhotos.removeBody: It comes out of the gallery for everyone.
parkPhotos.removeFailed: Couldn't remove the photo. Try again.
parkPhotos.reorderFailed: Couldn't move the photo. Try again.
